items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Buster said, 'I don't want to go back to Bennie Moten.' ... 'Bennie ain't doing nothing.'

ctx.x: Then they'd all come back for a great ensemble all together. Now, Dixieland, I would say the New Orleans topped them on Dixieland. But for swing and more organized bands like Blue Devils and Basie and all those kind of bands, you know, I mean like Basie played with Blue Devils and Bennie Moten and T. Holder and bands like -- New Orleans didn't have those kind of bands.
What about the Morton Red Hot Peppers? Were you aware of those?
